purpose: Post-repair acceptance: prove BLACK consumes a new job and Node/npm/npx/OnchainOS are reachable without hanging.
command:
set -u
date -u +%FT%TZ
id
printf 'node='; timeout 5s node -v
printf 'npm='; timeout 5s npm -v
printf 'npx='; timeout 5s npx --version
printf 'onchainos_path='; command -v onchainos || true
printf 'onchainos_version='; timeout 8s onchainos --version 2>&1 || true
echo BLACK_POST_REPAIR_ACCEPT_OK
